onboarding.perms.micDetail: 在输入框里语音听写，转写在本机完成。
onboarding.tour.composer: 这里是你与机器人对话的地方。输入任何内容并按 {key}。每一段对话都是真正干活的代理。
onboarding.tour.model: 每个机器人都有自己的大脑。这个芯片显示其模型；点一下即可切换，即使在对话途中也一样。
onboarding.tour.computer: 机器人有手。这个按钮会打开机器人的屏幕，让你看着它工作。我们来打开它。
onboarding.tour.model-simple: 点击上方的机器人名称即可打开它的面板。它的指示、日程和应用都在“Details”标签页中，你可以随时修改。
onboarding.tour.computer-simple: 机器人有手。机器人的面板会显示它在哪里工作，你还可以看着它的屏幕。我们来打开它。
onboarding.tour.computer-browser: 机器人的屏幕。在这里切换它的桌面与专属浏览器。在浏览器里，它会阅读网页并替你填写表单。
onboarding.tour.tools: “工具”菜单。已连接的应用程序、自动化与团队地图都在里面。我们来打开它。
onboarding.tour.apps: 已连接的应用程序。Gmail、Slack、GitHub、Notion，还有数百个其他服务。我们来看看。
onboarding.tour.apps-panel: 应用程序市集。登录一次即可连接应用程序；每个机器人都有自己的“设置 → 访问权 → 已连接的应用程序”访问权设置。我们会关掉这个，继续往下。
onboarding.tour.automations: 自动化。依调度运行，或被 webhook 调用时启动的机器人。我们来打开它。
onboarding.tour.automations-page: 行事历。把机器人拖到某个时间点，它就会自行运行；结果会回到它的对话中。按“下一页”带你回到对话。
onboarding.tour.done: 导览结束，你回到了对话。你的手机、终端机与其他所有功能都在“设置”里。你随时可以从“设置”→“一般”重播。
onboarding.spot.composer: 这里是你与机器人对话的地方。⌘K 可以找到任何机器人、群组或消息。
onboarding.spot.model: 这个机器人使用这里显示的模型运作。你随时可以变更它，即使在对话途中也一样。
onboarding.spot.approval: 当机器人需要你的同意时，会用这样的卡片来询问。你可以允许或拒绝。
onboarding.spot.connector: 当机器人需要你尚未连接的应用程序时，会在这里询问。在浏览器登录一次即可连接应用程序；每个机器人都可以单独启用“已连接的应用程序”访问权。
onboarding.reel.title: 你的机器人能做什么
onboarding.phone.title: 你的手机
onboarding.cloud.title: Keep your bots working while you sleep
onboarding.cloud.body: MausBot Cloud 会在云端运行你的机器人。即使这台电脑关机，它们也会全天候持续工作。
onboarding.cloud.routines: Routines run on time, day and night
onboarding.cloud.phone: Talk to your bots from your phone
onboarding.cloud.move: Bring everything over in one click
onboarding.cloud.trial: Free for {days} days, then from {price}/month + tax.
onboarding.cloud.later: You can add a Cloud any time from the switcher.
onboarding.reel.agents.title: 每一段对话都是实际运作的代理
onboarding.reel.agents.body: 侧边栏中的每个机器人都有自己的记忆、技能与个性。像与联系人交谈一样和它们对话。
onboarding.reel.hands.title: 它们有手
onboarding.reel.hands.body: 每个机器人都能拥有自己的浏览器和屏幕、已连接的应用程序与语音。观看它工作，或接手操作。
onboarding.reel.setup.title: 输入 /setup，它会自己完成配置
onboarding.reel.setup.body: 以 /setup 开头发消息，描述你想做的事。机器人会问几个问题，然后自己设置好名称、日程、应用和工作文件夹。它会告诉你还剩什么需要你做，比如登录某个应用。
onboarding.reel.channels.title: 把机器人放进群组
onboarding.reel.channels.body: 一个群组可以容纳多个机器人与你。用 @ 提及其中一个来决定由谁回应。让工作、个人与各个项目彼此分开。
onboarding.reel.automations.title: 设置好就放着不管
onboarding.reel.automations.body: 把机器人放到行事历上，它就会自行运行。给外部应用程序一个 webhook 地址，机器人就会在被调用时醒来。
onboarding.reel.terminal.title: 也能从终端机运行
onboarding.reel.terminal.body: 输入 npx openmausbot，选一个大脑，同一个应用程序就会在你的浏览器中打开。也可以配对手机，或在一台一直开着的机器上运行它。
onboarding.bot.title: 认识你的第一个机器人
onboarding.bot.intro: 给它一个名字、一个颜色，以及一件它应该永远记住的事。这些之后都可以在它的设置中修改。
onboarding.bot.chiefIntro: 你的助理会和你一起完成工作，需要时还会请来专家。给它取个名字、选个颜色，之后都可以修改。
onboarding.bot.name: 机器人名称
onboarding.bot.soulPlaceholder: 回答简短，并展示你的推论过程。
onboarding.bot.error: 无法保存这个机器人。你可以直接完成，之后再从它的设置中编辑。
chief.addBotStarter: 我想再要一个机器人来帮我。问问我它该做什么。
onboarding.hosted.intro: This is your team's shared OpenMausBot. Everyone who joins sees the same bots, chats and files. Your organization provides the AI models, so there is nothing to install.
onboarding.shared.title: Your team's shared OpenMausBot
onboarding.shared.body: Bots, chats and files here are shared with your team. Your administrator sets up the AI models and settings, so you can start chatting right away.
settings.welcome.title: 欢迎导览
settings.welcome.subtitle: 首次使用的导览：模型提供方、权限、手机，以及你的第一个机器人。
settings.welcome.subtitleShort: 最初的几步：你的名字，以及连接一个 AI。
engineSetup.terminalSignInCheck: Installed. Finish signing in to your account in Terminal, then choose Check again.
engineSetup.sameMachine: 请在运行 OpenMausBot 的电脑上，以同一用户安装并登录。如果是远程连接，指的是 OpenMausBot 运行的那台机器，而不是这台设备。然后选择“重新检查”；无需重启应用。
engineSetup.pathHint: Already installed but still not detected? In Settings → Model providers and accounts, expand CLI path and updates and use Set CLI to choose the executable.
engineSetup.checkFailed: Could not refresh provider status. The previous status is still shown. {reason}
engineSetup.invalidStatus: 无法获取你的 AI 状态。请再检查一次。
engineSetup.installNotVerified: The installer finished, but the provider is not usable yet. {reason}
engineSetup.installVerified: Installation verified. Sign in if requested.
engineSetup.openedHint: 终端已打开。粘贴命令并按回车。
engineSetup.copyOnOpenHint: 终端打开时会自动复制命令。
engineSetup.downloadNote: 从 Google 下载 {mb} MB。OpenMausBot 会在使用前进行校验。
engineSetup.startingGoogle: 正在启动 Google 登录…
engineSetup.openGoogleAgain: 重新打开 Google 登录
engineSetup.antigravitySlow: 启动 Antigravity 最多可能需要 90 秒。准备好后会自动打开你的浏览器。
engineSetup.otherComputerHint: 当 Google 跳转到一个无法加载的页面时，把该页面的完整网址粘贴到这里。
engineSetup.googleNoLink: Google 登录没有返回链接。
engineSetup.managedSignIn: 每个 Antigravity 配置都有自己的 Google 账号。安全登录由你的浏览器完成。
engineSetup.terminalSignIn: 请在终端里完成账号登录。之后重新打开此菜单，我们会再检查一次。
engineSetup.injectDesc: 安装一次该智能体，之后就能用本地模型运行——不需要云端登录。
engineSetup.managedDesc: OpenMausBot 会安装自己校验过的 Antigravity 运行时。它独立于 Antigravity 应用和 agy CLI；在这里安装并用 Google 登录后，这个模型列表会从你的账号刷新。
engineSetup.installDesc: 安装一次命令行应用。就绪后模型就会出现在这里。
engineSetup.installDescSignIn: 安装一次命令行应用。就绪后模型就会出现在这里；之后可能还需要登录。
engineSetup.noReason: 这台机器上没有这个模型提供方。
engineSetup.noInstaller: 该平台没有一行式安装脚本。请使用下面的安装指南。

engineSetup.apiKey.title: {name} needs an API key
engineSetup.apiKey.description: Paste your key in Settings → API keys. It saves and checks itself, and the models show up here.
engineSetup.apiKey.remote: Add the key in Settings → API keys on the computer running OpenMausBot.
engineSetup.apiKey.configuredDescription: To fix a typo or use a new key, replace or clear it in Settings → API keys.
engineSetup.apiKey.configuredRemote: To change the key, open Settings → API keys on the computer running OpenMausBot.
engineSetup.serverInstalling: 正在安装。这可能需要一分钟。
engineSetup.serverInstalled: 已安装。正在检查模型提供方。
engineSetup.serverInstallDesc: OpenMausBot 会在其运行所在的机器上安装命令行应用程序，以专属用户身分安装在自己的文件夹中。不需要终端机；之后可能需要登录。
engineSetup.serverUpdateDesc: OpenMausBot 会在其运行所在的机器上更新命令行应用程序。不需要终端机。
settings.experimental.title: 实验功能
settings.experimental.subtitle: 早期功能在测试期间可能有所变动。每项功能都会标示默认为打开或关闭。
settings.experimental.error: 无法保存实验功能的设置。
settings.experimental.skillAuthoring: Bots may write their own skills
settings.experimental.skillAuthoringDeta: On by default. Save a bot's verification run as a skill from the Verify card, or ask a supported bot to run /create-verification-skill. Each new or changed skill shows in the chat with Undo.
settings.experimental.skillReviewDetail: Off by default. After a bot has run enough tool steps in a conversation, it reviews that conversation in the background and may create or improve its own skills. The review uses the bot's engine and counts toward spend limits. Each change shows in the chat with Undo.
settings.experimental.skillReviewNeedsAu: Turn on “Bots may write their own skills” first.
settings.experimental.skillReviewSteps: Review after this many tool steps
settings.experimental.skillReviewStepsRa: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
settings.experimental.shareSkills: Share learned skills with the department
settings.experimental.shareSkillsDetail: When a bot learns or improves a skill, it moves into the skills library and every bot in the same department gets it. Conversations already running hear about it on their next message; new ones list it. A teammate with its own skill of that name keeps it.
settings.experimental.shareSkillsNeedsAu: Turn on “Bots may write their own skills” first.
settings.experimental.shareSkillsAria: How learned skills are shared with the department
settings.experimental.skillReviewNoEngin: Bots on {engines} won't learn skills this way: their engine can't run the background review.
settings.experimental.browserOn: 已为此安装实例启用。每个机器人还有自己的浏览器开关。
settings.experimental.browserOff: 默认关闭。打开后，支持的机器人会使用一个你能看到并随时接管的浏览器标签页。
settings.experimental.browserWindows: 此 Windows 机器上尚不可用：用 `openmausbot browser install` 安装浏览器。
settings.experimental.newBrowserDetail: Off by default. Bots' browsers run on OpenMausBot's own Chrome driver instead of agent-browser: pages render at your screen's sharpness, and bots can handle uploads, downloads, dialogs and pop-ups. Profiles that use your own Chrome are not affected. Switching closes open browsers, and sign-ins saved in one do not carry over to the other.
browser.notInstalled: 这里尚未安装浏览器。请在“应用设置 → 设备”和机器人的“访问”设置中打开浏览器开关，然后打开“机器人的屏幕 → 浏览器”进行安装。也可以在应用运行的地方运行 `openmausbot browser install`。
browser.panel.typeTextTitle: Type into the selected page field
browser.panel.enableBot: Enable the browser in this bot's profile to use it.
browser.panel.installIncompleteHelp: agent-browser is installed, but Chrome setup has not finished. Retry the browser installation.
browser.panel.installing: Installing… (a one-time download of about 160 MB)
browser.panel.enterAddress: Enter a web address or something to search for.
browser.panel.confirmRestart: Restart this profile’s browser? Open tabs will close. Saved logins are kept. Stop any bots using it first.
browser.panel.heldElsewhere: Another window or device controls this browser. Hand control back there to use it here.
browser.panel.connectionInterrupted: Connection interrupted. Reconnecting the browser view…
browser.panel.connectionEnded: Browser connection ended. Reconnect to continue watching.
browser.panel.asleep: This browser closed after it sat unused, to save memory.
browser.passkey.title: This browser can’t use your passkey
browser.passkey.body: {provider} is asking for a passkey from your phone or computer. A bot’s browser can’t reach it, so this step won’t finish here. What works instead:
browser.passkey.appsGoogle: For Gmail, Calendar or Drive, connect Google as an app. {name} then works without signing in here.
browser.passkey.appsMicrosoft: For Outlook, Calendar or OneDrive, connect Microsoft as an app. {name} then works without signing in here.
browser.passkey.otherWayGoogle: To sign in here anyway, choose Try another way on this page, then use your password and a code from your authenticator app, a text message or a backup code.
browser.passkey.otherWayMicrosoft: To sign in here anyway, choose Other ways to sign in on this page, then use your password and a code from your authenticator app, a text message or a backup code.
browser.passkey.lentPc: 你的电脑 {computer} 已与 Cloud 共享：请让 {name} 在那台电脑上用浏览器登录，你的通行密钥在那里可以使用。你在那台电脑上批准即可。
browser.passkey.lendPc: 或者在你 PC 上的桌面应用中，于“设置 → MausBot Cloud”开启“让我的机器人使用这台 PC”，并包括应用和屏幕。之后 {name} 就能使用那台 PC 上的浏览器，你的通行密钥在那里可用。
browser.control.yoursHint: {name}’s browser tools are paused while you use it. Control goes back to {name} after a few seconds without input.
browser.control.stale: {name} was busy, so that wasn’t sent. Try again.
browser.control.keptHint: {name}’s browser tools are paused until you hand back.

browser.typeSecret.field: Password or code for the page
browser.typeSecret.note: It goes only to the page. OpenMausBot does not keep, log or show it.

signIn.banner: needs you to sign in to {site}

signIn.where.vm: 请在 {name} 工作的私有桌面上登录。点“打开”会连同“接管控制”一起显示。

signIn.where.host: Sign in on the computer OpenMausBot runs on, in the browser {name} is using.

signIn.private: You type the password into the page yourself. OpenMausBot never sees it.

browser.live.botBusy: {name} is using this browser. The live view opens when it’s free…
browser.input.tooSlow: Browser input stopped because the browser is not keeping up with it (it may be stuck, or the connection may be slow). Reconnect the view before typing again. If it stays stuck, restart the browser.
browser.profiles.heldElsewhere: Another window is using this browser. Switch profiles once it’s done.
browser.profiles.busy: Profiles unlock once the current browser action finishes.
browser.viewport.keysHint: Once you click or type in the page, your keys go to it; until then Tab moves on. Press Shift+Escape to return to the browser address bar.
settings.profiles.title: 浏览器配置
settings.profiles.subtitle: 任何机器人都能使用的具名登录会话。在机器人的浏览器标签页里创建一个；登录一次就会一直保留。
settings.profiles.empty: 还没有配置——在机器人的浏览器里选择“+ 添加配置…”。
settings.profiles.deleteError: 无法删除该浏览器配置。
settings.profiles.confirm: 删除“{name}”？{bots} 这会永久退出该配置的登录并清除它的浏览器数据。
settings.profiles.confirmOneBot: {name} 会切换到自己的浏览器会话。
settings.profiles.confirmManyBots: {count} 个机器人会切换到各自的浏览器会话。
settings.profiles.deleteTitle: 删除此配置并忘记它的登录信息
settings.profiles.busyOne: {names} 仍在运行。删除这个浏览器配置前请先停止该机器人。
settings.profiles.busyMany: {names} 仍在运行。删除这个浏览器配置前请先停止这些机器人。
settings.profiles.sharedSubtitle: 供你的机器人共用的浏览器登录。请在这里创建配置，再于机器人的“浏览器”分页中选用。
settings.profiles.sharedEmpty: 尚无共用配置。每个机器人仍有自己的浏览器。
settings.profiles.temporary: 暂时 — 不保存登录信息
settings.profiles.temporaryHint: 临时会话只会在应用运行期间保留登录信息。它们不会保存到磁盘。
settings.profiles.sharedHint: 使用自己的浏览器可让登录信息仅限此机器人。使用同一个共用配置的机器人则会共用相同的登录信息。
settings.profiles.stopToSwitch: 请先停止此机器人的回合，再切换浏览器配置。
settings.profiles.limit: 最多可保留 20 个共用配置。
settings.profiles.ownerOnly: 只有此安装实例的管理员可以管理浏览器配置。
settings.profiles.refreshError: 无法刷新浏览器配置。请重新加载此页面后再试一次。
settings.profiles.removed: 此配置已移除。请选择其他浏览器配置。
settings.profiles.deleteUsers: 这些机器人将改用自己的浏览器：{names}。
settings.profiles.myChromeHint: Bots on this profile act inside your real Chrome, signed in as you, with your cookies and your open tabs. Use it for sites that refuse the built-in browser, such as Google sign-in. To connect, open chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging in Chrome and turn remote debugging on; Chrome asks you to allow the connection. Sign in and out of sites in Chrome itself.
settings.profiles.myChromeUnavailable: “我的 Chrome”适用于桌面应用，机器人会在你自己的电脑上运行。在其他任何地方（例如 Cloud）都没有你自己的 Chrome 可用，因此所有配置文件都会使用内置浏览器。
settings.sites.title: Signed-in sites
logins.siteHint: The address of the page with the password box. The login fills anywhere on that site (accounts.example.com and www.example.com are both example.com), never on another site.
logins.passwordKeep: New password (leave empty to keep the saved one)
logins.totpKeep: New 2FA setup key (leave empty to keep the saved one)
logins.totpHint: The key or otpauth:// address a site shows when you set up an authenticator app. With it, the one-time code is filled too.
logins.private: Encrypted on the computer OpenMausBot runs on and never shown again. Bots never see it: OpenMausBot types it into the login page for them.
settings.logins.title: Logins
settings.logins.subtitle: Website logins your bots can sign in with. A bot never sees the password: OpenMausBot types it into the login page for it, and only on that login's own site.
settings.logins.adminOnly: Only an admin of this installation can see and change saved logins.
settings.logins.empty: No saved logins yet. Add one here, or choose Save a login when a bot asks you to sign in.
settings.logins.exactHost: Only on this exact address, not elsewhere on its site
settings.logins.limits: Bots get the password typed into the page, never as text, and it is hidden from anything they read back. A screenshot of the page can still show what a site displays, so save logins only for sites you trust your bots with.
settings.logins.onePassword.title: 1Password
settings.logins.onePassword.guide: Let bots sign in with logins from 1Password. In 1Password, create a service account that can read one vault only, such as “Shared with OpenMausBot”, then paste its token here.
settings.logins.onePassword.connected: Connected to {vaults} · {count} logins with a website
settings.logins.onePassword.note: The token is encrypted on the computer OpenMausBot runs on and never shown again. 1Password logins appear in the list above, filled the same way, and are changed in 1Password. A vault is for every bot unless you choose bots for it.
settings.logins.cloudOwn: 这些是 Cloud 自己的登录信息。当那台电脑上的 OpenMausBot 把你的机器人移到这里时，你电脑上的登录信息也会自动传过来。
settings.sites.none: Not signed in to any site.
settings.sites.shared: {names} share this browser: signing out here signs all of them out.
settings.sites.error: Could not read this browser's sign-ins.

keys.opencode.desc: 可选。已有的 OpenCode Zen、Go 等提供方连接会自动识别。
keys.opencode.link: 打开 OpenCode 提供方指南
keys.opencode.providersHint: More providers for OpenCode bots (Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, or your own router): run {command} in a terminal, then refresh OpenCode’s models under Model providers.

vm.safety.title: 安全与存储
vm.safety.perBot: Cua Driver 只操作每台虚拟机的桌面。每个机器人都有一个挂载在 {path} 的私有主机文件夹；它的文件和浏览器配置在虚拟机被替换后依然保留。查看器只绑定回环地址，并且基于机器人推导出的精确目标可防止一个机器人接入另一个机器人的容器。每台虚拟机都保持 4 GB、2 CPU、512 进程以及去除特权的限制。虚拟机仍可访问互联网。
vm.safety.shared: Cua Driver 只操作虚拟机的桌面。恰好有一个私有主机文件夹挂载在 {path}；那里的文件和浏览器登录在虚拟机被替换后依然保留，而虚拟机内的其他内容都是可丢弃的。带密码保护的查看器只能在本机访问。Docker 和 Podman 的运行限制为 4 GB 内存、2 个 CPU 和 512 个进程；除桌面主管切换到非特权用户所需的两项外，所有 Linux 能力都会被去除。虚拟机仍可访问互联网，机器人按顺序轮流共享它。

backup.scope: 这个安装实例的密码保护备份，涵盖机器人、对话、指示、本机文件与非机密设置。此浏览器的草稿与偏好设置也会一并纳入。
